title: Nightly prod→dev sync has failed 4 nights running: scrub.sql's *_enc loop NULLs fleet_proxies.url_enc, which is NOT NULL
failure_scenario: Every night the restore transaction rolls back (good: dev is not wiped, no prod tokens leak), but dev keeps serving the 2026-10-27 copy of prod: 4+ days of stale data so far and growing; anyone testing on dev against 'real data' (accounting, fleet, Reddit leads 0219 which prod now has) is testing against an old snapshot, and dev's own schema drift (e.g. fleet_cities.pinned dropped on dev only, see A5-02) is no longer being healed. It will stay broken until scrub.sql changes.
